description: Header file defining the 'byte_buffer' class and related utilities for managing non-contiguous byte sequences using linked list segments, including creation, copying, appending, prepending, slicing, and formatting functionalities within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: byte_buffer
classes.description: Represents a non-contiguous byte sequence managed via linked list segments, supporting creation, copying, appending, slicing, and formatting.

classes.name: byte_buffer_slice
classes.description: Represents a sub-interval or make_slice of a byte_buffer, sharing ownership of segments.

classes.name: byte_buffer_reader
classes.description: Facilitates reading a range of bytes from a byte_buffer.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an empty byte_buffer with a specified segment pool.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a byte_buffer from a span of bytes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a byte_buffer from an initializer list of bytes.

methods.name: deep_copy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the byte_buffer.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs a shallow copy of the byte_buffer, sharing ownership.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends bytes or ranges of bytes to the byte_buffer, possibly allocating new segments.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends bytes or byte buffers to the byte_buffer.

methods.name: trim_head
methods.description: Removes bytes from the head of the byte_buffer.

methods.name: trim_tail
methods.description: Removes bytes from the tail of the byte_buffer.

methods.name: linearize
methods.description: Moves bytes into a contiguous segment.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the byte_buffer without initializing new bytes.

methods.name: segments
methods.description: Returns a range of segments composing the byte_buffer.
